votes.motion: Accept the donation of a native tree as a memorial to Gen Ness, Cheryl Shaw, and Katie Kiefer, to be installed at the town beach by Lakeview Nurseries; location to be set by the Facilities Director, his group and the donating group (amendment by K. Menard).
votes.quote: k. menard made a motion to accept the donation gift of the native tree as a memorial to gen ness, cheryl shaw, and katie kiefer to be installed at the town beach by lakeview nurseries.
k. menard made a motion to nominate a. lockwood for chair. c. sullivan seconded.
c. shapiro made a motion to nominate c. sullivan for vice-chair. k. menard seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).
a. lockwood made a motion to nominate k. menard for clerk. c. sullivan seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).

votes.motion: Designate K. Menard to represent the Parks Commission on the Master Plan Steering Committee.
votes.quote: a. lockwood made a motion to designate k. menard to represent the parks commission on the steering committee. c. shapiro seconded. roll call vote.motion carried (4-0).

votes.motion: Add the construction end date of June 30, 2024 to the upcoming contract between the Park Commission and the Lunenburg Skate Park Organization.
votes.quote: c. sullivan made a motion to add the construction end date of june 30, 2024 to the up coming contract that will be drafted
